core.text: Tell me about a time you worked with someone else to accomplish something.
Tell me about a time you had several responsibilities or deadlines. How did you manage them?
Tell me about a time you learned something new or received feedback. What did you do with it?

first_job.label: My First Job
first_job.scenario: Imagine you are busy with a task and someone asks for help. What would you do?

food_service.label: Fast Food & Food Service
food_service.scenario: Imagine the restaurant is busy and a customer tells you their order is wrong. What would you do?

retail.label: Retail Associate
retail.scenario: Imagine you are stocking shelves when a customer asks for help finding something. What would you do?

customer_service.label: Customer Service
customer_service.scenario: Imagine a customer is frustrated because something did not go as expected. How would you respond?

wex.label: Work Experience (WEX)
wex.scenario: Imagine your supervisor gives you a task you have never done before. How would you make sure you understand what to do?

electrician.label: Electrician (Entry Level)
electrician.scenario: Imagine a teammate needs help while you are finishing an important task. How would you communicate and decide what to do safely?

nursing_assistant.label: Nursing Assistant (Entry Level)
nursing_assistant.scenario: Imagine someone needs help while you are already busy. How would you communicate and follow workplace directions?

manufacturing.label: Manufacturing / Team Assembler
manufacturing.scenario: Imagine a team member is falling behind on a task. How would you help while keeping your own work and safety in mind?

cdl_driver.label: Commercial Driver (Entry Level)
cdl_driver.scenario: Imagine you are running behind schedule and someone needs an update. How would you communicate and handle the situation safely?
